scripts.build:native: mkdir -p native/bin && clang -fobjc-arc -fblocks native/SpeechTranscriber.m -o native/bin/peel-speech -framework Foundation -framework Speech -Wl,-sectcreate,__TEXT,__info_plist,native/VoiceHelper-Info.plist
scripts.build:main: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:native && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.package: electron-packager . Peel --out out --overwrite --platform darwin --arch arm64 --app-bundle-id com.peel.desktop --extend-info build/Info.plist --asar.unpackDir=native/bin --ignore='(^|/)(src|test|e2e|node_modules/.cache)(/|$)'
